content.value_statement: Teams forget why major technical choices were made. This skill helps draft, review, and organize ADRs with clear context, alternatives, and consequences.
actual_capabilities: Provides a docs/adr folder structure and file naming examples.
Supplies an ADR template with context, decision, alternatives, results, risks, and references.
Shows completed ADR examples for framework and database decisions.
Defines numbering ranges, status values, and a review workflow.
Includes a checklist for project setup and ADR quality review.
Lists optional adr-tools commands and external ADR references.
limitations: It does not validate architecture choices against the actual codebase.
It does not enforce ADR numbering or status changes automatically.
Some examples are written in Korean and may need translation.
Optional CLI commands require adr-tools to be installed separately.

use_cases.title: Record Framework Decisions
use_cases.description: Capture why a team selected a frontend, backend, database, or library option over alternatives.

use_cases.title: Onboard New Engineers
use_cases.description: Create a readable decision history that explains past tradeoffs for new team members.

use_cases.title: Review High Impact Changes
use_cases.description: Use ADRs during pull requests to document infrastructure, security, or platform decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic ADR
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for one clear decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use adr-log to draft an ADR for choosing PostgreSQL. Include context, alternatives, decision, consequences, risks, and references.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Draft ADR
prompt_templates.scenario: Improve an existing decision record before review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my draft ADR for clarity, missing alternatives, weak rationale, and unclear consequences. Suggest specific edits.

prompt_templates.title: Build an ADR Index
prompt_templates.scenario: Organize several decision records for a project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ADR index for these decisions with numbers, titles, statuses, dates, and short summaries.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Superseding ADR
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for replacing an older decision.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these related ADRs and draft a new ADR that supersedes the outdated decision. Explain migration impact and remaining risks.

output_examples.input: We chose Next.js App Router for a new marketing and product site.
output_examples.output: A complete ADR with accepted status, decision context, compared alternatives, expected benefits, tradeoffs, risks, and reference links.

output_examples.input: Our team needs a decision history for database and authentication choices.
output_examples.output: An ADR folder plan, numbering scheme, index outline, and checklist for consistent future records.

output_examples.input: An older ADR chose MongoDB, but the product now requires stronger relational integrity.
output_examples.output: A superseding ADR that explains the changed context, compares migration options, and records consequences for the team.

best_practices: Write an ADR soon after team alignment, while the rationale is still clear.
Document serious alternatives and tradeoffs, not only the final choice.
Use a new ADR to supersede old decisions instead of silently rewriting history.
anti_patterns: Do not use ADRs for small implementation details with no lasting impact.
Do not write only the chosen option without context or rejected alternatives.
Do not keep decisions only in chat, meetings, or pull request comments.

faq.question: What is an ADR?
faq.answer: An ADR is a short document that records an important architecture decision and the reason behind it.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when a technical decision affects architecture, dependencies, security, operations, performance, or long term maintenance.

faq.question: Can it create ADR files for me?
faq.answer: It can help draft file content and structure when the AI tool has permission to edit your workspace.

faq.question: Does it require adr-tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill includes optional adr-tools examples, but plain markdown files are enough for ADR documentation.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: How should old decisions be changed?
faq.answer: Mark the old ADR as superseded and create a new ADR that explains the updated decision.
